__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source with the Tyk Developer Portal metrics

title: Tyk Developer Portal
description: Tyk Enterprise Developer Portal: provider sync with Tyk Dashboard, database and file storage probes, and uptime.

panels.title: Environment
panels.description: Deployment environment this portal runs in. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Portal instances
panels.description: Developer Portal instances currently reporting. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the most recently started portal instance came up. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Last successful sync
panels.description: How long ago the provider that synced longest ago last synced with Tyk Dashboard. Thresholds assume the default 10 minute refresh interval. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.last_success_timestamp

targets.expr: label_replace((max(time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} > 0))) < 1200, "state", "✓ Under 20 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((max(time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} > 0))) >= 1200 < 1800, "state", "⚠ 20 to 30 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((max(time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} > 0))) >= 1800, "state", "✕ Over 30 min ago", "", "") or on() ((label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -2) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) >= 900), "state", "ProviderMetrics off, or no providers set up", "", "") or label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -3) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) < 900), "state", "First sync not finished yet", "", "")) unless on() count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))

panels.title: Unreachable providers
panels.description: Providers whose Tyk Dashboard the portal could not reach or authenticate to on the last sync. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.reachable

targets.expr: label_replace((count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) == 0) or on() (0 * count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"})))) == 0, "state", "✓ All reachable", "", "") or label_replace((count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) == 0) or on() (0 * count(min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"})))) > 0, "state", "✕ Not reachable", "", "") or on() ((label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -2) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) >= 900), "state", "ProviderMetrics off, or no providers set up", "", "") or label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -3) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) < 900), "state", "First sync not finished yet", "", "")) unless on() count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))

panels.title: Failed provider syncs
panels.description: Provider syncs that failed in the last 30 minutes, all providers and causes. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.failures

targets.expr: label_replace((sum(increase(tyk_portal_provider_sync_failures_total{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[30m])) or on() (0 * count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))) < 0.5, "state", "✓ No failures", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(tyk_portal_provider_sync_failures_total{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[30m])) or on() (0 * count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))) >= 0.5, "state", "⚠ Syncs failed", "", "") or on() ((label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -2) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) >= 900), "state", "ProviderMetrics off, or no providers set up", "", "") or label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -3) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) < 900), "state", "First sync not finished yet", "", "")) unless on() count(tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))

panels.title: Database
panels.description: The portal database. Shows whether its latest ping passed within 5 seconds, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.portal.health

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(min by (store) (tyk_portal_health{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",component="database"}), "store", "SQLite", "store", "sqlite3"), "store", "MySQL", "store", "mysql"), "store", "PostgreSQL", "store", "postgres"), "store", "Filesystem", "store", "fs"), "store", "Amazon S3", "store", "s3"), "store", "Portal database", "store", "db") or on() ((label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -2) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) >= 120), "store", "HealthMetrics off", "", "") or label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -3) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) < 120), "store", "First probe not run yet", "", "")) unless on() count(tyk_portal_health{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))

panels.title: File storage
panels.description: Where the portal keeps themes and uploaded files. Shows whether its latest read check passed within 5 seconds, worst result across instances. Metric: tyk.portal.health

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(min by (store) (tyk_portal_health{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",component="storage"}), "store", "SQLite", "store", "sqlite3"), "store", "MySQL", "store", "mysql"), "store", "PostgreSQL", "store", "postgres"), "store", "Filesystem", "store", "fs"), "store", "Amazon S3", "store", "s3"), "store", "Portal database", "store", "db") or on() ((label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -2) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) >= 120), "store", "HealthMetrics off", "", "") or label_replace((0 * max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) + -3) and on() (max(process_uptime_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}) < 120), "store", "First probe not run yet", "", "")) unless on() count(tyk_portal_health{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))

panels.title: Telemetry export
panels.description: Whether the portal's metrics are reaching this data source. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Providers
panels.description: Each provider with its last successful sync, whether the portal could reach its Tyk Dashboard, failures in the last hour and how long a successful sync takes. Thresholds assume the default 10 minute refresh interval. Metrics: tyk.portal.provider.sync.last_success_timestamp, .failures, .duration, tyk.portal.provider.reachable

targets.expr: 0 * (label_replace((time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} > 0)) < 1200, "state", "✓ Under 20 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} > 0)) >= 1200 < 1800, "state", "⚠ 20 to 30 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - max by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} > 0)) >= 1800, "state", "✕ Over 30 min ago", "", ""))

0 * (label_replace((min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"})) == 1, "reach", "✓ Reachable", "", "") or label_replace((min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"})) == 0, "reach", "✕ Not reachable", "", ""))

sum by (provider_id) (increase(tyk_portal_provider_sync_failures_total{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}[1h])) or on (provider_id) (0 * min by (provider_id) (tyk_portal_provider_reachable{service_name="tyk-portal",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"}))

panels.title: Tyk Dashboard reachable per provider
panels.description: Whether the portal could reach and authenticate to each provider's Tyk Dashboard, over the selected time range. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.reachable

panels.title: Time since last successful sync
panels.description: How long ago each provider last synced. It drops back to near 0 after every successful sync. The lines mark 20 and 30 minutes. Thresholds assume the default 10 minute refresh interval. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.last_success_timestamp

panels.title: Failed syncs by cause
panels.description: Failed provider syncs per hour, by cause. An expired or wrong Tyk Dashboard secret shows as Authentication. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.failures

panels.title: Syncs per hour
panels.description: Provider syncs that finished per hour, all providers, split into succeeded and failed. At the default interval each provider syncs 6 times an hour. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.duration

panels.title: Sync duration (p95)
panels.description: How long the slowest 5% of provider syncs took, all providers, with succeeded and failed syncs kept apart. Metric: tyk.portal.provider.sync.duration

panels.title: Dependency probes
panels.description: Whether the database ping and the file storage read check passed within 5 seconds, over the selected time range. Metric: tyk.portal.health

panels.title: Uptime per instance
panels.description: Time since each portal instance started. A drop to near 0 is a restart. Metric: process.uptime
